title: the exit abort after H-52: Arrow's IO pool and a Python buffer

findings.claim: after H-52 a one-shot process that reads a Parquet table from Python bytes with pq.read_table(..., use_threads=False) can still abort at exit (status 134): the dataset scanner runs on Arrow's IO pool, whose worker can release the Python buffer after the interpreter began to finalize; the box rehearsal, the doctor and the H-52 loop test can fail after the read succeeded
findings.severity_basis: a person misled (a false FAIL of the doctor, the host check or CI that a rerun clears); the box can be installed
findings.fix: the four in-memory reads use pq.ParquetFile(src).read(use_threads=False), which starts no thread; guarded by tests/unit/test_parquet_single_thread_guard_h52.py and tests/unit/test_parquet_read_exit_abort_h52.py::test_rehearsal_read_starts_no_thread
findings.from: lane J's report on PR #1220 (log not found); on master under load 1 of 4200 runs died, with the IO pool worker's backtrace; 0 of 4200 with the fix
